meta.description: University of Mumbai — one of India's oldest and largest universities, affiliating 700+ colleges.

description: One of India's premier universities with 700+ affiliated colleges. Offers B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc., B.Com, B.A., M.E., M.Tech, M.Sc., MBA, MCA, and Ph.D. programs. Follows CBCS with a 7-point/10-point grading system. Recently adopted NEP 2020 curriculum.

academic_calendar.details: Odd semester: Jun-Nov, Even semester: Dec-May. Exams typically in Nov (odd) and May (even).

available.name: Mumbai University CBCS 2019 Pattern
available.description: Choice Based Credit System with 40% IA + 60% ESE, 7-point grading

available.name: Mumbai University NEP 2023 Pattern
available.description: NEP-aligned pattern with 5 units, 100 marks per subject (40 IA + 60 ESE)

available.name: Mumbai University Revised 2016 Pattern
available.description: Pre-NEP pattern for engineering with 5 units, 80 marks ESE + 20 marks IA
